benchmark: S2 filtered pgvector HNSW synthetic spike

configuration.ann_planner_setting: enable_seqscan=off to require an HNSW path for the index-only comparison
configuration.exact_baseline: Same predicates/order; indexscan and bitmapscan disabled; EXPLAIN checked for a sequential scan and no HNSW index.
configuration.per_query_settings: pgvector and planner GUCs are explicitly set before every probe and timed query

limitations: Synthetic isotropic Gaussian vectors and tenant distributions are not representative production data.
Client latency includes loopback and asyncpg round-trip overhead; retained EXPLAIN ANALYZE plans include server execution and buffer counts.
No RLS policies are installed or evaluated; query predicates are not evidence of RLS enforcement.
No user-approved recall or latency target exists; measurements are observations, not pass/fail gates.
No partial index was added; this synthetic workload does not establish a stable production predicate or index maintenance trade-off.
The container resource snapshot is sampled after benchmark queries, not a peak-resource profile.
